title: Ingest and atomize source documents
body: Ingest source documents (Google Docs preferred, and direct upload also supported) and atomize them into reusable components.

title: Direct upload and custom integrations
body: Support other sources through direct upload, with custom integrations to be scoped as needed (for example, Hive tables via API).

title: Meta document types and slide atomization
body: Support Meta's document types (CMDs, rec briefs, MRDs, APDs, staging briefs), including per-slide atomization of decks with metadata where needed.

title: Source documents stay the source of truth
body: Source docs remain the source of truth; scale target is hundreds of documents, kept lean.

title: Google Drive sync
body: Sync from Google Drive centralized folders using a configurable schedule, manual sync on demand, or a change notification from Google Drive, with the change notification preferred by Meta.

title: Detect content-level changes
body: On each sync, detect content-level changes (not just timestamps) and update only the affected atoms.

title: Onboard new templates with calibration
body: Support onboarding of new document templates and types, with a human-guided calibration pass.

title: Tune extraction inside the knowledge base
body: Tune ingestion behavior (extraction and atomization) directly within the knowledge base, including editable extraction prompts and taxonomy guidelines with versioning.

title: Exact quotes and proof points
body: Quoted content and proof points must be an exact 1:1 match, including punctuation, because they are legally approved and in some cases contractually required.

title: Consistent atomization, no synthesis
body: Atomization output must be consistent and complete, with no drift and no synthesis.

title: Unchanged source produces the same atoms
body: Unchanged source, no edits: re-running ingestion produces the same atoms, with no duplicates and no new versions.

title: Content edits survive re-ingestion
body: Unchanged source, atoms edited by a content person: edits are preserved and not overwritten by a re-run.

title: Changed source updates only affected atoms
body: Changed source: content hashes at the document and atom level identify exactly which atoms changed, and only those are updated. Each update arrives as a new draft version with a side-by-side diff, and a content person reviews it before it is published.

title: Flag true duplicates, not lookalikes
body: Duplicate handling: flag when the same document is loaded twice, but treat similar documents written for different audiences as separate. IDs intentionally reused across documents (such as guidance IDs) must not trigger false matches.

title: Auto-tag with review and override
body: Auto-tag atoms during ingestion, with the ability to review and override.

title: Tag only predefined taxonomies
body: Tag only against predefined taxonomies, never invented tags.

title: Semaphore is the taxonomy source of truth
body: Use a shared taxonomy as the source of truth (a few hundred tags), kept in Meta's existing taxonomy tool (Semaphore) and synced to Hygraph. Example coverage includes Meta audience segments (SBG, in-market, mid-market), sensitivity labels (Internal, External, and 1:1 NDA), and DSS classifications.

title: Product name changes cascade
body: Product name changes (which can happen overnight) must cascade to all tagged atoms, with separate internal and external product names supported.

title: Trace every atom back to the source
body: Full traceability from atom to atomized document to original source, with side-by-side verification.

title: Legal and brand approval workflows
body: Approval workflows for legal and brand review, with role-based permissions, notifications, and a status view.

title: Versioning with a diff view
body: Versioning with a diff view when source documents change.

title: Internal content stays internal
body: Internal-only content must never surface in external-facing outputs.

title: Cited, approved outputs
body: Every atom cited and traceable, with outputs that are brand and legal approved.

title: Governed payloads by API and MCP
body: Deliver governed payloads via API and MCP (read and write, with documented rate limits) to Meta's own tools (Campaign Studio and the internal sales AI assistant). Meta owns the front ends.

title: Hygraph owns search and vectorization
body: Hygraph owns vectorization and semantic search, providing low-latency, high-accuracy retrieval.

title: Multi-asset support, DAM-agnostic
body: Multi-asset support (images, GIFs, large video files), DAM-agnostic.

title: Home for official sales decks
body: Serve as the home for official sales decks, replacing Highspot.

title: Keep sales decks intact
body: Keep decks intact in a dedicated folder rather than atomizing them. The source documents behind them are atomized instead, and sales never sees those.

title: Marketers upload, sales pulls
body: Marketers upload only; sales pulls only.

title: View-only access to the sales folder
body: Role-based, view-only access scoped to the sales folder (internal, external, and 1:1 NDA tagging), with no separate front end to build.

title: Search, find, and download
body: Simple search, find, and download. Sales edits a copy rather than the official version.

title: Tags and descriptions on every asset
body: Tag with Meta's taxonomy and include description fields so assets are understandable without opening them.

title: Search slides and video by meaning
body: Support Google Slides, PowerPoint, and video files (such as .mov keynote clips) searchable by meaning. Images are lower priority and logos are not stored for this use case.

title: Citation and helpfulness stats
body: Citation and helpfulness stats per atom, with the ability to export to Meta's data lake and analytics tools.

title: Atom-level view rate
body: Atom-level performance metrics (percentage view rate) using data sourced from Meta systems.

title: Meta-branded knowledge base
body: Meta-branded, white-labeled knowledge base UI.

title: AI security and confidentiality
body: Strong AI security and data confidentiality.

title: Authentication including SCIM
body: Authentication options including SCIM (to be delivered).

title: Hygraph carries the build
body: No Meta engineering effort to build and maintain. Hygraph's forward-deployed engineers, product managers, and designers carry the project, with a fast path for fixing issues when something goes wrong.

title: Rapid-response support
body: Rapid-response support and the ability to adapt quickly to changes in direction.
